# trackgta6.com – GTA 6 Guide & 100% Tracker

> Fan-made, unofficial guide to Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) with a free 100% completion tracker.
> The tracker lists missables, collectibles, side activities and trophies by region of Leonida, with photos,
> and is updated from launch day (19 November 2026) by a player on PS5. Progress is saved in the visitor's browser.

## Main pages
- [100% completion tracker](https://trackgta6.com/tracker/): checklist of missables, collectibles, activities and trophies, filterable by region
- [Launch times](https://trackgta6.com/launch/): live countdown and the exact unlock time in every country
- [Editions and prices](https://trackgta6.com/editions/): Standard vs Ultimate, prices by country
- [FAQ](https://trackgta6.com/faq/): quick answers (unlock time, PC version, consoles, download size, online) with sources
- [Characters](https://trackgta6.com/characters/): Jason, Lucia and the rest of the revealed cast
- [Places](https://trackgta6.com/places/): Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga
- [Gameplay](https://trackgta6.com/features/), [Radio stations](https://trackgta6.com/radio/), [Videos](https://trackgta6.com/videos/)

## Data
- [Tracker data (JSON)](https://trackgta6.com/data.json): every tracker item with id, name, region, note and flags
